p2p_port.description: Port on which the daemon listens for incoming P2P connections.

p2p_bind_ip.description: IP address to bind the P2P interface to. Use '127.0.0.1' to restrict to local only.

p2p_no_igd.description: Disable Internet Gateway Protocol (NAT-PMP/UPnP) port forwarding. Default is true (disabled).

rpc_port.description: Port for the JSON-RPC API (used by wallets, explorers, and tools).

rpc_bind_ip.description: IP to bind the RPC server to. Keep '127.0.0.1' for local-only access for security.

rpc_login.description: Authentication credentials in 'username:password' format. Leave empty for no auth.

rpc_restricted.description: Restrict RPC to known outputs, incoming transactions, and the wallet daemon. Set to true for tighter security.

data_dir.description: Directory where the blockchain and wallet data are stored.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. If empty or omitted, logs go to stderr.

limit_download.description: Rate limit for inbound traffic in KB/s. 0 means no limit.

limit_upload.description: Rate limit for outbound traffic in KB/s. 0 means no limit.

dnssec_enabled.description: Enable DNSSEC validation for Monero DNS seeds. Set to true to enable (internal flag inverts for no-dns-secure).

seed_nodes.description: Optional list of trusted seed nodes (host:port) for bootstrap. Leave empty to use default seeds.

exclusive_nodes.description: List of trusted daemon nodes to exclusively use for syncing.

additional_nodes.description: Additional nodes to try connecting to.

pruning_enabled.description: Enable blockchain pruning to reduce disk usage.

mining_enabled.description: Enable local mining. Requires CPU and significant power — only for test or dedicated mining setups.

mining_address.description: Monero address to receive mined rewards. Required if mining is enabled.

background_mining_enabled.description: Allow background mining when system is idle.

upnp_enabled.description: Enable UPnP port mapping. Use with caution.

fee_override.description: Override minimum fee (e.g., '0.00001' XMR per KB).

sync_snapshot_url.description: URL of a Monero blockchain snapshot for fast initial sync.

zmq_enabled.description: Enable ZeroMQ for real-time pub/sub of blocks/transactions.

zmq_pub_tx_addr.description: ZMQ address to publish raw transactions.

zmq_pub_block_addr.description: ZMQ address to publish new blocks in JSON format.

zmq_pub_raw_block_addr.description: ZMQ address to publish raw (binary) blocks.

extra_lines.description: Unparsed additional configuration lines to append verbatim.
